AdditionEntry.title: AdditionEntry
AdditionEntry.description: A saved two-number addition calculation owned by an authenticated user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

firstNumber.description: First operand entered by the user.

secondNumber.description: Second operand entered by the user.

total.description: Computed sum of firstNumber and secondNumber.

note.description: Optional short label for the calculation (max 80 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/additions/{additionId}.description: User-scoped collection of saved two-number addition calculations.
